changelog:
Initial release of "AI大模型专家｜短剧悬念钩子与卡点":

- Provides workflows and templates for generating, managing, and validating cliffhanger story beats, character boards, and scene assets for short drama and comic studios.
- Supports scriptwriters, brands, e-commerce, and cross-border teams by structuring creative goals into executable outline, prompts, and media generation tasks.
- Integrates with AI-HIVE for unified image and video model access, real-time model/pricing snapshots, and material/task management.
- Includes code examples for blueprint creation, version comparison, image/gen, video/gen, and task querying.
- Offers customized versions for major short drama, vertical video, and comic platforms both in China and overseas.
- Ensures commercial-grade delivery with workflow for approval, cost control, result tracking, and content safety/legality validation.
